name: Swarmer
notes: Small, fast and weak; comes in groups. Moves faster than the brute (Jay's note). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
description: Little shadow scraps that dart in groups. Watch for the quick jab, then answer it.

bestiary.tip: Swarmers move fast, but they always show their jab first.

lore.white: When the light broke, tiny bits of shadow scattered like dust. They are fast, but they are not brave alone.
lore.yellow: Higher up, the shadow scraps learn to move together. Stay calm and face them one at a time.
lore.orange: The swiftest scraps live here. They are quick, but a steady student is quicker.
